title: 25 July 2026: Pradhan Resigns, Protests End #Shorts
description:
Reuters, CNN, ANI: Is a resignation enough, or must exam reform come first?
On 25 July 2026, Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan announced his resignation after youth-led protests over alleged exam paper leaks. CNN reported that the Cockroach Janta Party then called off its protests with immediate effect. Our view: the system responded, and the real test now is safer exams and quick action against anyone who leaks a paper.
Sources: Reuters, CNN, ANI and The Tribune (25 July 2026 resignation); CNN (Cockroach Janta Party calling off protests). Photo of Dharmendra Pradhan: Wikimedia Commons (credit and licence on the file page).
This video is commentary, and opinion segments are clearly marked. The anchors and some visuals are AI-made.
#IndianPolitics #PoliticsExplained #ViksitBharat #Shorts
script:
SLOT: Short 1 of 2 today, 21:00 IST. English only; Hindi dub is automatic.

ROHAN: One cabinet minister. One resignation. Here's the Cockroach protest story so far.
KAVYA: On 25 July 2026, Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan announced his resignation, after days of youth-led protests over alleged exam paper leaks. Reuters, CNN and ANI all reported it.
ROHAN: The protests were led by the Cockroach Janta Party, founded by Abhijeet Dipke. CNN reported the group then called off its protests with immediate effect.
KAVYA: OPINION: The minister stepped down under pressure, and the protest ended. In our view, that shows the system responded instead of digging in.
ROHAN: OPINION: Now the real test is reform: safer exams, and quick action against anyone who leaks a paper.
KAVYA: Still open: which exam reforms will actually be delivered, and when? Sankalp will track it.
ROHAN: Resignation enough, or reform first? Comment one word. Follow Sankalp for the day's politics, from the government's side.

CAST (fixed, no cast call): Rohan (en-IN-PrabhatNeural, -6Hz; navy suit, white shirt, no tie). Kavya (en-IN-NeerjaNeural, -4Hz; maroon blazer, ivory top, low bun, pearl studs). Tagged as AI anchors.
